warning_texts: R05 was not checked by any deterministic rule beyond field presence (questions_are_answered requires only question and facts), so the false caveat there was caught only by this review; answer caveat text in general is unchecked by the plan.

independent_claim_recalc.json lists raw_data/orders.csv as its source path and check_plan.json declares claims_recomputed over raw_latest, while the stage prompt describes it as rooted in clean_data; either way it is not rooted in analysis/ or release/, so it is not self-checking and this is recorde

R03 and R04 carry the method, alpha, correction and n_per_group of the registered hypotheses but do not name the groups explicitly; the group order is inferable only from the plan's assumption that direct is first, and the n values match direct then partner.

audit/human_decisions.yaml and audit/prompts/COMMON_CONTRACT.md are not in this attempt's allowed input paths and were not read; the common contract text embedded in the stage prompt was used instead.
Recomputation used quarantine/orders.csv (in the handoff's input_globs) with dedup by last row in file order; dedup by latest updated_at gives the identical population (0 disagreements).

scipy was unavailable, so Student t and normal quantiles came from closed-form approximations in evidence/recompute_claims.py; the resulting bounds agree with the gate to well within 0.01 EUR and 0.000001.

One exploratory shell command (directory listing plus reading the handoff) was refused by the permission layer and did not run; files were then read with the file-reading tool only, and the only writes are evidence/recompute_claims.py, its output evidence/recompute_claims.out.json and this result.
summary: All six claims recompute independently from quarantine/orders.csv and chain byte-for-byte to calculated_metrics.json and analysis_plan.json (values, bounds, n, level, method, caveats, R03/R04 test statistics). One blocker: analysis/answers/R05.json states that every shipping cell was readable, that the shipping total is complete and that it was omitted only for brevity; the spec, the check plan's excuse for shipping_total and a recount (2648 of 44531 in-period orders have a blank, NaN or inf shipping cell) all contradict it.
